hook_text: Sector or segment? One pizza settles it forever.
clip_script: A sector is a region bounded by two radii and the arc between them. It looks like a slice of pizza. A segment is a region bounded by a chord and the arc it cuts off. Do not confuse them: a sector always has the centre as a corner, because it is made of two radii.
visual_style: A pizza is cut into a centre slice labelled sector and then a straight edge cut labelled segment; chord and arc labels trace the edges.
pacing: Two cuts, two labels, side-by-side comparison.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to name every part of a circle on a bicycle wheel.
